_doc: Replay flag per tool registration. 'safe' tools may be re-invoked after a restart; 'unsafe' tools never rerun, and an interrupted call is reported as an error result that says it may have partially run. 'gated' lists tools whose side effect needs user approval: the registration is 'safe' because it only rereads the approval table, and the effect itself sits behind a once-only delivery row keyed by the approval key (spike B3, t4-b3.md).

gated.when: the command is not a pure discovery command
gated.gate: safe step keyed by the approval key, rereads the adapter-owned approval table
gated.effect: runs once behind a delivery row with a unique approval key, even though a shell command is otherwise unsafe to rerun
